description: A diesel long-block on a steel pallet, shrink-wrapped and stencilled with a six-digit part number and a warning in two languages. Somebody has chalked a date on the block. It weighs what an engine weighs: it goes where a forklift takes it and stays there until somebody bolts it into something.
name: crated truck engine

tags.description: A diesel long-block on a steel pallet, shrink-wrapped and stencilled with a part number in six digits and a warning in two languages. Somebody has chalked a date on the block itself. It weighs what an engine weighs, which is to say you aren't carrying it anywhere: it goes where a forklift takes it and it stays there until somebody bolts it into something.
